title: Very, a Little, and Saying It Twice
label: ch:mr-degree
canDo: I can turn any adjective I own up or down without learning a new one, and I can strengthen a word further by repeating it.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R53-very and run one adjective through three strengths -- jaraa uMch, khuup uMch, khuup khuup uMch -- with the ending untouched every time.
payoff.note: The chapter teaches no adjective at all: it multiplies the eight the reader already has, which is why it belongs immediately after them.
